name: Atreyu
label: Victory Records
lede: Kids from Yorba Linda named their band after a boy in The Neverending Story, took Victory Records to number 9 on the Billboard 200, and twenty-two years later parted ways with the singer who started it all at 14.

eras.title: Retribution becomes Atreyu
eras.text: A punk band started by 14-year-olds in Yorba Linda, California, turned into Atreyu, named for a character in Michael Ende's The Neverending Story. Two small EPs and a lot of local shows got them to Victory Records in Chicago.

years.h: Retribution renames itself Atreyu, after The Neverending Story
years.p: Alex Varkatzas and Dan Jacobs had started the punk band Retribution at about 14. As the line-up and sound changed, they took the name of Atreju, the boy warrior in Michael Ende's novel The Neverending Story.
years.xp: Brandon Saller came in on drums at the invitation of his older brother Ryan Saller. Kyle Stanley was on bass and Travis Miguel on guitar.

years.h: Visions, Atreyu's seven-song first EP
years.p: A self-released EP Atreyu sold at its own shows around Orange County, years before any label was involved.

years.h: Fractures in the Facade of Your Porcelain Beauty on Tribunal
years.p: Atreyu's five-song EP for the underground label Tribunal Records. Tulips Are Better, Someone's Standing on My Chest and Living Each Day Like You're Already Dead would be reworked for the first album.
play: Fractures in the Facade of Your Porcelain Beauty

years.h: Atreyu signs to Victory Records; Chris Thomson takes over bass
years.p: Tony Brummel's Chicago label signs the Orange County band in 2001. Bassist Kyle Stanley quits and Chris Thomson steps in for the first album.

eras.title: Too goth to be emo, too metal to be punk
eras.text: On Victory, Atreyu mixed Alex Varkatzas's screams with Brandon Saller's sung choruses from behind the drum kit, and eyeliner with Gothenburg riffs. PopMatters' Adrien Begrand said they were too goth for emo, too metal for punk and too emotional for metal. The Curse made them the label's hottest band.

years.src: Wikipedia: Suicide Notes and Butterfly Kisses
years.h: Suicide Notes and Butterfly Kisses, the Victory debut
years.p: Produced by Eric Rachel at Trax East and two other studios. The working title was The Death Rock Diaries. It's the only Atreyu album with Chris Thomson on bass.
years.xp: By March 2006, according to Nielsen SoundScan figures cited on Wikipedia, it had sold more than 240,000 copies worldwide. In 2004, two years after release, it charted at number 37 on Billboard's Heatseekers and number 30 on Top Independent Albums.

years.h: Lip Gloss and Black gets played on MTV's Headbangers Ball
years.p: Atreyu's video for Lip Gloss and Black gets airplay on MTV2's Headbangers Ball and Fuse's Uranium, with Ain't Love Grand as the other video from the debut.

years.h: Marc "Porter" McKnight replaces Chris Thomson on bass
years.p: Marc McKnight joins Atreyu in 2004 and stays through every line-up to come. He has cited Green Day as his foundational band and found Johnny Cash through Bleeding Through.

years.h: The Curse debuts at 32 and tops the indie chart
years.p: Produced by GGGarth partly at Plumper Mountain Sound in Gibsons, British Columbia. Atreyu's second album hits number 32 on the Billboard 200 and number 1 on Independent Albums.
years.xp:
Videos for Right Side of the Bed and The Crimson were all over MTV2 and Fuse. Wikipedia notes a hired studio bassist played on the record even though McKnight was in the band.

The album went on to sell more than 500,000 copies and was certified gold by the RIAA on September 14, 2020, sixteen years after release.

years.h: Right Side of the Bed lands in Burnout 3: Takedown
years.p: Atreyu's single goes into EA's crash-racing game Burnout 3: Takedown, putting a Victory metalcore band in front of millions of gamers.

years.h: Atreyu covers Bon Jovi for Mr. & Mrs. Smith
years.p: Atreyu's version of Bon Jovi's You Give Love a Bad Name goes on the soundtrack of the Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie film.
years.xp: Around the same time Her Portrait in Black went onto the Underworld: Evolution soundtrack.

eras.title: Top ten, then out the Victory door
eras.text: A Death-Grip on Yesterday put a Victory Records metalcore band at number 9 on the Billboard 200. Then Atreyu jumped to Hollywood and Roadrunner, went arena-rock with John Feldmann, and toured with Avenged Sevenfold and Linkin Park.

years.cap: A Death-Grip on Yesterday, Victory Records, 2006
years.h: A Death-Grip on Yesterday debuts at number 9
years.p: Atreyu's third album and last for Victory, produced by Josh Abraham with the band at Pulse Recording in Los Angeles. It enters the Billboard 200 at 9 and tops Independent Albums.
years.xp: Victory shipped it with a DVD of the making of the album plus videos by other Victory artists. Reviews were mixed: 2/10 from the Collector's Guide to Heavy Metal, 5/10 from PopMatters, positive from AllMusic and Punknews.

years.h: Ex's and Oh's goes on Madden NFL 07 and up the rock chart
years.p: The first Death-Grip single makes the Madden NFL 07 soundtrack and reaches number 24 on Billboard's Hot Mainstream Rock Tracks, with Brandon Saller's singing and Alex Varkatzas's screaming split more evenly than before.

years.h: Atreyu leaves Victory for Hollywood Records and Roadrunner
years.p: Atreyu signs with Disney-owned Hollywood Records for America and Roadrunner Records for the rest of the world.

years.h: Lead Sails Paper Anchor hits 8 and goes gold
years.p: Produced by John Feldmann, Atreyu's first Hollywood Records album swaps metalcore for big hard rock. It debuts at number 8 and becomes the band's best seller, certified gold.
years.xp: To launch Becoming the Bull, the band's site ran a jigsaw puzzle that unlocked audio clips. American copies closed with a cover of Faith No More's Epic; European and Australian ones with the Descendents' Clean Sheets.

years.h: Atreyu headlines a stage on Linkin Park's Projekt Revolution
years.p: After Taste of Chaos dates with Avenged Sevenfold and Bullet for My Valentine, Atreyu headlines the Revolution Stage of Linkin Park's 2008 tour, playing 45-minute sets over Hawthorne Heights and Armor for Sleep.
years.xp: That spring Atreyu co-headlined Australia and New Zealand with Avenged Sevenfold and Bullet for My Valentine, and headlined Taste of Chaos in the UK with Story of the Year and As I Lay Dying. On April 22, 2008, Lead Sails Paper Anchor came back as a 2.0 edition with new art, bonus tracks and a DVD.

years.src: Wikipedia: Congregation of the Damned · Wikipedia: Atreyu
years.h: Congregation of the Damned: Atreyu gets heavy again
years.p: Bob Marlette produces at Henson Studios in Los Angeles. It opens at number 18 with about 26,000 copies, and Brandon Saller says parts of Atreyu had gone missing.
years.xp: Varkatzas called the record a mix of everything the band had done. It had sold 121,000 US copies by August 2015. The band promoted it with five webisodes released every two weeks from September 1 to October 20.

eras.title: Taking a break to recharge
eras.text: After a decade on the road Atreyu stopped, and everyone went off to make something else. Three years later a Facebook post promised a return to the sound of The Curse.

years.h: Alex Varkatzas tweets that Atreyu is going on break
years.p: Varkatzas says the band will take time to recharge and focus on other parts of their lives. He starts I Am War with Brandan Schieppati of [[Bleeding Through|55fd865d-4a0d-4fd0-af19-7e6feb168ab8]].

years.h: Brandon Saller's Hell or Highwater releases Begin Again
years.p: Saller's hiatus band, first called The Black Cloud Collective, plays clean-sung rock with no screaming. In December Travis Miguel's Fake Figures put out the EP Hail the Sycophants.
years.xp: Miguel later spent about 18 months in 2013 and 2014 as a touring guitarist for Trapt.

years.h: Atreyu announces it is making music again
years.p: The same five members return. On September 5 they post So Others May Live on YouTube and as a free download, and in October play Slipknot's Knotfest.

eras.title: Long live, then the split
eras.text: The reunion produced two albums and a 20th-anniversary tour with a setlist the fans chose. Then, in 2020, the band and its founding screamer went separate ways.

years.h: Long Live, Atreyu's comeback album, enters at 26
years.p: The first Atreyu album in six years reaches number 26 on the Billboard 200, after a Record Store Day 7" of 1,000 copies on April 18.

years.h: In Our Wake, the last album with Alex Varkatzas
years.p: Atreyu's seventh album, toured that fall with Memphis May Fire and Ice Nine Kills.

years.h: A 20th anniversary tour with a setlist fans voted on
years.p: Atreyu books 27 cities with Whitechapel and He Is Legend, playing a 20-song set chosen by fans. Kyle Rosa fills in on drums.

q: we invented metalcore. That may sound cocky but I don't care
years.src: Wikipedia: Atreyu · Wikipedia: Alex Varkatzas · Wikipedia: Baptize
years.h: Atreyu and founding singer Alex Varkatzas part ways
years.p: Rumors surfaced August 22 and Varkatzas denied them at first. On September 30 both sides confirmed it. Brandon Saller moves out front, Marc McKnight takes screams and Kyle Rosa joins on drums.
years.xp:
Wikipedia's article on Baptize says Varkatzas worked on that album shortly before being removed from the band, and he kept writing credits on it. In June 2021 he announced a new band, Dead Icarus, whose debut album ZEALOT came out October 31, 2024.

Years earlier Varkatzas had made the band's boldest claim, that Atreyu predated Poison the Well and Killswitch Engage.

eras.title: Brandon Saller out front
eras.text: The drummer who used to sing the choruses now fronts the band. Atreyu made records with Travis Barker, released EPs one by one, re-cut its best-loved album and went back on Warped Tour, while Dan Jacobs said out loud what he thought of Victory.

years.h: Baptize, with Travis Barker on Warrior
years.p: John Feldmann produces the first post-Varkatzas album, on Spinefarm, with [[Blink-182|0743b15a-3c32-48c8-ad58-cb325350befa]]'s Travis Barker, Papa Roach's Jacoby Shaddix and Trivium's Matt Heafy guesting. Metacritic scores it 51.

q: Tony Brummel and his awful, scummy ways
years.h: Dan Jacobs slams Tony Brummel on a podcast
years.p: In a 2021 podcast interview, Atreyu's guitarist speaks ill of Victory Records and of its founder Tony Brummel.
years.xp: Victory had released Atreyu's first three albums. The label had fought in court with other acts, among them [[Hawthorne Heights|194eeda1-e662-43bc-b9be-32fc1afecc8b]] and A Day to Remember.

years.h: The Hope of a Spark starts a run of three EPs
years.p: Atreyu drips out The Hope of a Spark, then The Moment You Find Your Flame on August 18 and A Touch in the Dark on November 3.

years.h: The Beautiful Dark of Life collects the EP run
years.p: Atreyu's ninth studio album gathers the EP songs into one record.

years.h: Atreyu re-records The Curse without Alex Varkatzas
years.p: The whole 2004 album is cut again, with Brandon Saller and Marc McKnight singing the parts Varkatzas and Saller once split.

years.h: Atreyu on Warped Tour and a new album, The End Is Not the End
years.p: Atreyu plays Welcome to Rockville in May, the revived Vans Warped Tour and Louder Than Life in Louisville in September.
